Web Crawler and Search Engine

网络爬虫与搜索引擎

Designing a Web Crawler and Search Engine

You have planned a get-together with your loved ones during the holiday season. You love cooking and have decided to cook all the food by yourself, but you don’t have the recipes for the dishes you wish to prepare. What is the best possible resolution here? You could ask your friends if they have the recipes or go looking through cookbooks, but a simple yet effective solution is using Google search. Google looks across the internet and finds the best results for how to prepare a specific dish. How does Google go through such a vast sea of information and find the perfect answer? In this chapter, we’ll try to figure this out by digging into the architecture of such search systems.

你计划在假期和亲人朋友小聚。你热爱烹饪，决定亲手做所有菜，但你没有想做的那些菜的食谱。这里最好的解决办法是什么？你可以问朋友有没有食谱，或去翻食谱书，但一个简单而有效的办法是用 Google 搜索。Google 横跨互联网，找到如何做某道菜的最佳结果。Google 如何穿越如此浩瀚的信息海洋找到完美答案？在本章中，我们将通过深入这类搜索系统的架构来试图弄清这一点。

At a high level, the entire system consists of two subsystems: a web crawler and a search engine, as shown in Figure 15-1. A web crawler is essentially software responsible for crawling through web content. Content on the internet is growing exponentially, and web crawlers need to regularly crawl the content to maintain the most updated results. The search engine sits on top of content accumulated by web crawlers and stores it in such a way that it can look for user-searched keywords in the content and present the most useful results.

从高层次看，整个系统由两个子系统组成：网络爬虫和搜索引擎，如图 15-1 所示。网络爬虫本质上是负责爬取 Web 内容的软件。互联网上的内容呈指数级增长，网络爬虫需要定期爬取内容以保持最新结果。搜索引擎位于网络爬虫积累的内容之上，并以一种方式存储它，使其能在内容中查找用户搜索的关键词，并呈现最有用的结果。

With this basic understanding, let’s start by gathering the functional and nonfunctional requirements of the proposed system.

有了这个基本理解，我们先从收集所拟系统的功能和非功能需求开始。

Page 409

System Requirements

Web crawlers can be used for multiple purposes, so focusing on one use case makes it easy to move in the right direction with our design. For this chapter, content retrieval via search engine is the main problem statement we’re trying to solve, but you could also look into other issues, such as web-monitoring tasks like copyright infringement. A web crawler is needed in the system to gather the data, but from the user’s perspective, the product is a search engine.

网络爬虫可用于多种目的，因此聚焦于一个用例能让我们的设计容易朝正确方向推进。在本章中，通过搜索引擎检索内容是我们要解决的主要问题陈述，但你也可以研究其他问题，例如像版权侵权这样的 Web 监控任务。系统中需要一个网络爬虫来收集数据，但从用户角度看，产品是一个搜索引擎。

Functional and Nonfunctional Requirements

The functional requirements of the system include:

系统的功能需求包括：

  • Getting the top results (web page title, subtitle, and URL) for a user search query
    为用户搜索查询获取最热门结果（网页标题、副标题和 URL）
  • Identifying the content freshness rate of the results, which are frequently updated
    识别结果的内容新鲜度——这些结果频繁更新

The NFRs include:

NFR 包括：

Highly available. The system can serve user queries most of the time.

高可用（Highly available）。系统在大部分时间都能服务用户查询。

Highly reliable. Queries should be served correctly.

高可靠（Highly reliable）。查询应被正确服务。

Highly scalable. The system should be able to handle increasing scale, such as number of webpages and content on those webpages.

高可扩缩（Highly scalable）。系统应能处理不断增长的规模，例如网页数量和这些网页上的内容。

Low latency for search queries. Even with the huge number of pages mapping to a user query, the system should return the most relevant results within milliseconds.

搜索查询低延迟。即使映射到用户查询的页面数量巨大，系统也应在毫秒内返回最相关的结果。

Page 410

Data freshness. The underlying storage to serve search queries should be regularly updated. Data consistency is not highly critical for this use case. A lag in content available on websites and searchable via the search engine is acceptable.

数据新鲜度（Data freshness）。服务搜索查询的底层存储应定期更新。对这个用例而言，数据一致性并不非常关键。网站上可用、可通过搜索引擎检索的内容存在一定滞后是可以接受的。

We should also document the system boundaries, or what the system is not expected to do. For this use case, that includes:

我们还应记录系统边界，即系统不被期望做什么。对这个用例，包括：

  • The system will not include recommendation and content-relevance algorithms for gathering the search results.
    系统不包含推荐和内容相关性算法来收集搜索结果。
  • The search doesn’t support near real-time search results—for example, the live score of an ongoing cricket match.
    搜索不支持近实时搜索结果——例如一场正在进行的板球比赛的实时比分。

Next, let’s jump to the expected scale for this system.

下面我们转入这个系统的预期规模。

System Scale

The system has two components: the web crawler and the search engine. Both components can be independent systems in themselves, and we’ll structure the chapter content to discuss them independently. This makes sense since the requirements of both these systems vary and they are expected to solve different use cases, with the output of one system (the web crawler) being used as input to the other system (the search engine). We’ll make some assumptions for each to determine the expected scale of the system.

系统有两个组件：网络爬虫和搜索引擎。这两个组件本身都可以是独立系统，我们将把本章内容组织成分别讨论它们。这是合理的，因为这两个系统的需求各不相同，预期解决不同用例，其中一个系统（网络爬虫）的输出被用作另一个系统（搜索引擎）的输入。我们将对各系统做一些假设，以确定系统的预期规模。

Web crawler

Important considerations for the web crawler are the number of pages on the web to be crawled and how often these pages need to be crawled. According to a quick Google search, around 1.13 billion websites have been created as of June 2023, and around 200 million of those are active. The web crawler system is only concerned with the active websites. Inside a single website, there can be internal redirects or external redirects to different pages. The external redirects are already counted as part of the 200 million websites, but we need to consider the internal redirects. We’ll make assumptions for the average numbers and use the following calculation to determine how much storage we’ll need:

对网络爬虫，重要的考虑是 Web 上要爬的页面数量，以及这些页面需要多久爬一次。根据一次快速 Google 搜索，截至 2023 年 6 月约有 11.3 亿个网站被创建，其中约 2 亿个是活跃的。网络爬虫系统只关心活跃网站。在单个网站内部，可能有到不同页面的内部重定向或外部重定向。外部重定向已经计入那 2 亿个网站之中，但我们需要考虑内部重定向。我们对平均数字做假设，并用以下计算确定需要多少存储：

Active websites = 200 million
Average pages/website = 50
Total pages = 200 million x 50 = 10 billion
Average page size = 2 MB
Page 411
Total storage = 2 MB x 10 billion = 20 PB

Web pages can include different forms of content, such as text, images, and videos. The web crawler should only crawl and keep the data that will be used by the search engine. We’ll limit the scope of the system to only support text queries in the English language. This will also potentially reduce the storage space—let’s say 500 KB per page, amounting to 5 PB of total storage. Another consideration here is the requirement to store the entire page.

网页可以包含不同形式的内容，例如文本、图片和视频。网络爬虫应只爬取并保留搜索引擎将使用的数据。我们将把系统范围限制为只支持英语文本查询。这还有可能减少存储空间——比如每页 500 KB，总计 5 PB 存储。这里另一个考虑是存储整个页面的需求。

The storage requirement calculated in this book assumes that content is stored in the same format as it is received, but this can certainly vary based on data store selection, data compression algorithms wherever applicable, separate caching data store, and so on.
本书计算的存储需求假设内容以接收时的相同格式存储，但这当然会根据数据存储选择、适用处的数据压缩算法、单独的缓存数据存储等而变化。

The content on the internet keeps adding up in the form of new websites and web pages, and the content on existing web pages is constantly updated. The system needs to ensure content freshness so that it stores the most relevant data to offer the ideal search experience.

互联网上的内容以新网站和新网页的形式不断增加，现有网页上的内容也在不断更新。系统需要确保内容新鲜，以便存储最相关的数据，提供理想的搜索体验。

Let’s look into the scale of the search engine system next.

下面我们考察搜索引擎系统的规模。

Search engine

What do we estimate the number of requests per second to the search engine system will be? Users open the browser and search with some keywords, and the system should be able to respond with search results that match the search query. Let’s consider Google’s scale since it is basically the most visited website in the world. Google serves roughly 8.5 billion searches per day (99,000 RPS). To support the search scale, data should be indexed, which requires storage space apart from what we discussed for the web crawler requirements.

我们估计搜索引擎系统每秒请求数是多少？用户打开浏览器，用某些关键词搜索，系统应能用与搜索查询匹配的搜索结果响应。我们以 Google 的规模来考量，因为它基本上是世界上访问量最大的网站。Google 每天服务约 85 亿次搜索（99,000 RPS）。为支持这个搜索规模，数据应被索引，这除了我们讨论过的网络爬虫需求之外还需要存储空间。

We’ll work to build a scalable system and talk about key concepts involved in the system, but keep in mind that Google has evolved a lot to support this scale, and it will not be possible to capture all such details in a single chapter. Here are some factors we should consider:

我们将努力构建一个可扩缩的系统，并讨论系统涉及的关键概念，但请记住 Google 为支持这个规模已经演进了很多，不可能在一章中涵盖所有这些细节。下面是我们应考虑的一些因素：

  • The search results can vary based on geographical region. For example, a search query with the keywords “latest news” might generate different results in India than it does in the US.
    搜索结果可能因地理区域而异。例如，用关键词“latest news”搜索，在印度可能产生与在美国不同的结果。
  • The system can receive similar search queries from different users, and it should include good caching capabilities to make queries faster.
    系统可能从不同用户收到相似的搜索查询，它应具备良好的缓存能力以加快查询。
Page 412

With these requirements and scale considerations, let’s now dig deeper into the design of the system.

有了这些需求和规模考虑，我们现在更深入地考察系统设计。

Starting with the Design

As we did in “System Requirements” on page 388, we’ll discuss the system design analysis for the web crawler and the search engine systems separately. Before we dig deeper into the design, we recommend reading through the Google architecture paper published in 1997. This paper nicely captures the high-level architecture of web crawler and search engine systems as shown in Figure 15-2 and serves as the starting point for the system-design analysis.

正如我们在第 388 页“系统需求”所做，我们将分别讨论网络爬虫和搜索引擎系统的系统设计分析。在深入设计之前，我们推荐通读 1997 年发表的 Google 架构论文。这篇论文很好地捕捉了网络爬虫和搜索引擎系统的高层架构，如图 15-2 所示，并作为系统设计分析的起点。

Here is a summary of the architecture presented in the technical paper:

下面是这篇技术论文所呈现架构的总结：

    To start the crawling process, a URL server provides a list of URLs to the crawler system to fetch web pages from the internet. Each crawler maintains its own DNS cache for faster lookups.

    为启动爬取过程，URL 服务器向爬虫系统提供一个 URL 列表，以便从互联网抓取网页。每个爬虫维护自己的 DNS 缓存以加快查找。

    The store server receives the web pages gathered by the crawler, and it compresses (using ZLIB compression) and stores the HTML content of every web page to a repository. The repository data structure is an independent component and can be used to build all the other data structures in the design.

    存储服务器接收爬虫收集的网页，它压缩（使用 ZLIB 压缩）并把每个网页的 HTML 内容存储到一个仓库。仓库数据结构是一个独立组件，可用于构建设计中的所有其他数据结构。

    The indexer reads the web pages from the repository, uncompresses them, and parses the content. The functions performed by the indexer include:

    索引器从仓库读取网页，解压它们并解析内容。索引器执行的功能包括：

Page 413
  • Parsing of content to ensure removal of any erroneous or unwanted content, such as non-ASCII characters.
    解析内容以确保移除任何错误或不需要的内容，例如非 ASCII 字符。
  • Assigning an identification, called a doc ID, to any new URLs (web links) found by parsing the web pages. All the important information about links, such as where the link is pointing from and to and the text of the link, is stored in data structures referred to as anchors.
    给通过解析网页发现的任何新 URL（Web 链接）分配一个标识，称为 doc ID。关于链接的所有重要信息，例如链接从哪指向哪、链接文本，都存储在称为 anchors 的数据结构中。
  • Converting every word into a word ID using an in-memory hash table called a lexicon.
    使用一个称为 lexicon 的内存哈希表，把每个词转换为 word ID。
  • Storing the occurrences of the word IDs in the document in a set of barrels in the form of partially sorted forward indexes called hits. The hits include the actual word, the position of the word in the document, the approximate font size, and capitalization. These characteristics help determine the relevance of words as compared to other words in the document; for instance, a large font size at the beginning of the document can represent the heading of the document.
    以部分排序的前向索引（称为 hits）的形式，把 word ID 在文档中的出现存储到一组 barrel 中。hits 包括实际的词、词在文档中的位置、近似字号和大小写。这些特征有助于判断词相对于文档中其他词的相关性；例如，文档开头的大字号可以表示文档的标题。

    The URL resolver reads the anchor files and converts relative URLs into absolute URLs, which map to the doc IDs, with these additional responsibilities:

    URL 解析器读取 anchor 文件，把相对 URL 转换为绝对 URL，这些 URL 映射到 doc ID，并承担以下附加职责：

  • Putting the anchor text into the forward index barrel associated with the doc ID that the anchor is pointed to
    把 anchor 文本放入与该 anchor 所指向的 doc ID 相关联的前向索引 barrel
  • Generating a database of links that are pairs of doc IDs; the link database is used to compute page rank for all the documents
    生成一个由 doc ID 对组成的链接数据库；该链接数据库用于计算所有文档的 page rank

    The sorter sorts the forward barrels (organized by doc ID) by word ID to generate the inverted index for the title, anchor hits, and full text. The sorter further divides a barrel into baskets of short or full barrels based on whether they can fit into main memory.

    排序器按 word ID 对前向 barrel（按 doc ID 组织）排序，以生成标题、anchor hits 和全文的倒排索引。排序器进一步根据 barrel 能否装入主内存，把一个 barrel 分成 short 或 full barrel 的 basket。

    A web server runs the searcher to serve the search queries. To process any search query, it parses the query, converts words into word IDs, seeks to the beginning of the doc list for every word in the search query in the short barrel, finds the document matching all the words, and computes the rank of the document. It then performs the same set of operations on the full barrel. Finally, it sorts the matching rank documents and returns the top one thousand as the response.

    一个 Web 服务器运行 searcher 来服务搜索查询。处理任何搜索查询时，它解析查询、把词转换为 word ID、在 short barrel 中为搜索查询中的每个词定位到 doc 列表的开头、找到匹配所有词的文档，并计算该文档的排名。然后它对 full barrel 执行同一组操作。最后，它对匹配排名的文档排序，返回前一千个作为响应。

Forward and inverted indexes are terms often used in search use cases. The forward index is a mapping of the doc ID to a set of words or keywords. The inverted index is an inverse mapping of the forward index containing the mapping from keywords to doc ID.
前向索引和倒排索引是搜索用例中常用的术语。前向索引是 doc ID 到一组词或关键词的映射。倒排索引是前向索引的逆映射，包含从关键词到 doc ID 的映射。
Page 414

Designing the Web Crawler

We’ll expand on the architecture from the previous section to design a scalable web crawler system. The first thing we’ll need to consider is the list of URLs that the system should start with (the seed URLs) for crawling the web. How should this list be maintained, and how should it be updated on a regular basis? There is no unified source that can be used to retrieve all the URLs to be used in the seed URL list. The only way to build this list is by starting out with the most-known domains (for example, the one thousand most popular domains) and then constantly updating the list on web crawls. The steps to building this list are:

我们将在上一节架构的基础上扩展，设计一个可扩缩的网络爬虫系统。我们首先要考虑的是系统应从哪些 URL 列表（seed URL）开始爬取 Web。这个列表应如何维护？应如何定期更新？没有一个统一来源可用于检索 seed URL 列表中要用的所有 URL。构建这个列表的唯一方法是从最知名的域名开始（例如最热门的一千个域名），然后在 Web 爬取中不断更新列表。构建这个列表的步骤是：

    Create a platform for new website owners to submit their site details to make them available for crawling.

    为新网站所有者创建一个平台来提交他们的站点详情，使其可供爬取。

    Retrieve the list of website links or references in the website being crawled.

    在被爬取的网站中检索网站链接或引用列表。

    When a user queries for a new website, check this website and add it to the list.

    当用户查询一个新网站时，检查该网站并把它加入列表。

The crawling frequency of the web crawler system is not fixed and can vary from website to website. Historical analysis of the website is one way to determine the crawling frequency. This helps determine if the website is frequently or rarely updated. News websites can be frequently updated with fresh content, but personal websites are usually updated more rarely.

网络爬虫系统的爬取频率不是固定的，可因网站而异。对网站的历史分析是确定爬取频率的一种方法。这有助于判断网站是频繁还是很少更新。新闻网站可能频繁更新新鲜内容，但个人网站通常更新更少。

Let’s discuss one potential architecture based on web page recrawling at a fixed, regular time interval, as shown in Figure 15-3. The architecture describes a potential implementation idea and has the following steps:

我们讨论一个基于固定、定期时间间隔重新爬取网页的潜在架构，如图 15-3 所示。该架构描述了一个潜在的实现思路，有以下步骤：

    The seed URLs database stores the URL with zero TTL or an appropriate TTL so that not all URLs are pushed to the queue at the same time. Implementation of change data capture upon TTL expiration can vary based on database choice; for example, DynamoDB streams can be leveraged.

    seed URL 数据库以零 TTL 或恰当 TTL 存储 URL，以便不是所有 URL 同时被推到队列。TTL 到期时变更数据捕获的实现可因数据库选择而异；例如可以利用 DynamoDB streams。

    Upon TTL expiration, URLs are pushed to the queue, and the web crawler consumes them.

    TTL 到期时，URL 被推到队列，网络爬虫消费它们。

    The web crawler retrieves the content of a web page from the internet and sends it for additional processing, such as building indexes.

    网络爬虫从互联网检索网页内容，并把它送去做额外处理，例如构建索引。

    The web crawler saves the URL again to the database with a new TTL. As the web crawler processes the web page content, extra web links are included, which are also pushed to the queue for processing.

    网络爬虫以新的 TTL 再次把 URL 存回数据库。当网络爬虫处理网页内容时，会包含额外的 Web 链接，这些链接也被推到队列等待处理。

Page 415

A web crawler system should have a change-detection algorithm deployed to efficiently figure out if the content is updated without crawling it entirely. Here are few ways to accomplish that:

网络爬虫系统应部署一个变更检测算法，以高效判断内容是否更新，而不必完全爬取它。下面是几种实现方式：

  • ETag (entity tag) is an HTTP response header that uniquely represents a requested source and is typically a hash of the content. The ETag value can be used to determine if the requested web page has changed. The Last-Modified HTTP response header containing the date and time of the last modification is another way of knowing when the resource was last updated.
    ETag（entity tag）是一个 HTTP 响应头，唯一表示被请求的源，通常是内容的哈希。ETag 值可用于判断被请求的网页是否改变。包含最后修改日期和时间的 Last-Modified HTTP 响应头，是知道资源最后更新时间的另一种方式。
  • Content comparison can validate content modification. However, it is definitely not an efficient process to compare word by word—this is essentially the same as reading the entire web page. A more efficient solution is figuring out specific portions of the page where the content is updated. One such solution is a Merkle tree (discussed in Chapter 3), which efficiently evaluates the updated section; it is generally used by databases like Dynamo to resolve anti-entropy among multiple replicas. Google crawler uses the Simhash algorithm to help figure out content duplication of web pages.
    内容比较可以验证内容修改。然而，逐词比较绝对不是高效的过程——这本质上等同于读取整个网页。更高效的方案是弄清页面中内容被更新的特定部分。一种这样的方案是 Merkle 树（第 3 章讨论过），它高效评估被更新的部分；它通常被 Dynamo 等数据库用于解决多副本间的反熵。Google 爬虫使用 Simhash 算法来帮助判断网页内容重复。
  • Occasionally, a website will become popular because a celebrity shared it over social media. The web crawler can detect such traffic surges, then recrawl the website for any content update.
    偶尔，一个网站会因为某名人在社交媒体上分享而走红。网络爬虫可以检测到这种流量激增，然后重新爬取该网站以查看任何内容更新。

Earlier, we mentioned a queue that can be used to push the URL for a web crawler to consume. The TTL approach based on time is not generally used directly in the large-scale web crawlers because the page to be crawled next can depend on many factors other than TTL. The TTL factor in web crawler terms is referred to as politeness, meaning how frequently a crawler fetches content from the web page server. This can happen too often if the URLs referenced in the web page belong to the same domain. Another important factor is figuring out the high-quality pages that need to be crawled as a priority. The system responsible for determining the next URL to be crawled in the web crawler architecture is generally called the URL frontier.

前面我们提到过一个队列，可用于把 URL 推给网络爬虫消费。基于时间的 TTL 方法通常不直接用于大规模网络爬虫，因为下一个要爬的页面可能取决于 TTL 之外的许多因素。网络爬虫术语中的 TTL 因素称为 politeness（礼貌），指爬虫从网页服务器抓取内容的频率。如果网页中引用的 URL 属于同一域名，这可能发生得过于频繁。另一个重要因素是弄清需要优先爬取的高质量页面。在网络爬虫架构中负责决定下一个要爬的 URL 的系统，通常称为 URL frontier。

Page 416

Improving the URL frontier

The previous architecture can be extended to address limitations and takes both priority and politeness into consideration. The architecture is referenced from the Mercator web crawler architecture and is shown in Figure 15-4.

前面的架构可以扩展以解决局限，并同时考虑优先级和礼貌。该架构参考自 Mercator 网络爬虫架构，如图 15-4 所示。

The functions of the different components of the URL frontier system are as follows:

URL frontier 系统各组件的功能如下：

Prioritizer and front queues. The prioritizer and front queues (first in, first out) are responsible for figuring out the priority in which the URL should be crawled by the web crawler system. The prioritizer assigns the priority to the URL from 1 to n, and based on this number, the URL is pushed to a specific front queue. The priority-assigning algorithm can take several factors into consideration, such as percentage change in the web page between two crawls, newness of the web page, user traffic on the page, and more.

优先级器与前队列（Prioritizer and front queues）。优先级器和前队列（先进先出）负责弄清 URL 应由网络爬虫系统以何种优先级爬取。优先级器把 1 到 n 的优先级赋给 URL，并根据这个数字把 URL 推到特定的前队列。优先级分配算法可考虑多个因素，例如两次爬取之间网页变化的百分比、网页的新旧程度、页面上的用户流量等等。

Front queue selector and back queue router. This component is responsible for taking the URLs based on the priority and passing them to the back queues. It maintains an additional database to keep domain-to-back-queue numbers to ensure that the URLs from the same host are served via a single back queue. This is done to make sure that a single domain is called once at most (or per the domain configurations at the search engine level) by the web crawler.

前队列选择器与后队列路由器（Front queue selector and back queue router）。这个组件负责根据优先级取 URL 并把它们传给后队列。它维护一个额外的数据库来保存域名到后队列编号的映射，以确保来自同一主机的 URL 通过单一后队列服务。这样做是为了确保网络爬虫对单个域名最多调用一次（或按搜索引擎级别的域名配置）。

Back queues. Back queues enforce politeness of the URL to ensure that the web server is not bombarded too frequently (a single request at a time, with some lag between the requests). The number of back queues should be more than the number of

后队列（Back queues）。后队列强制执行 URL 的礼貌策略，以确保 Web 服务器不会被过于频繁地轰炸（一次一个请求，请求之间有一定间隔）。后队列的数量应多于系统中可用的

Page 417

crawler threads available in the system to ensure that every thread is busy at any given time. This can be configured as three times the number of threads to start and later tuned with proper performance testing of the system.

爬虫线程数量，以确保任何时刻每个线程都在忙。这个数字初始可配置为线程数的三倍，之后通过对系统做恰当的性能测试来调优。

Priority queue. The priority queue is a heap implementation that stores one entry for each back queue and provides the time at which a particular host (or domain) can be contacted again. The heap is created upon min-heap implementation, and the root element provides the URL that can be contacted first.

优先级队列（Priority queue）。优先级队列是一个堆实现，为每个后队列存储一个条目，并提供特定主机（或域名）下次可被联系的时间。该堆基于最小堆实现创建，根元素提供可最先被联系的 URL。

Back queue selector. The back queue selector interacts with the heap to take out the root containing the domain with the minimum time and then take out the URL from that particular back queue. Once the URL is crawled by the crawler, the heap is updated with the new time to configure a new politeness value.

后队列选择器（Back queue selector）。后队列选择器与堆交互，取出包含最小时间域名的根，然后从该特定后队列取出 URL。一旦该 URL 被爬虫爬取，堆就用新时间更新，以配置新的礼貌值。

The FIFO queues in the architectures keep a fixed number of URLs in the main memory and store most of the URLs on the disk to support a high crawl rate on commodity hardware. Even with the best machines, disk support is required, considering the scale of the internet. The disk-storage algorithms can become a bottleneck for processing a huge number of URLs due to very frequent reads and writes to the disk, as pointed out in the IRLBot research paper, which tested results with 184,000 new URLs generated per second from crawled web pages.

这些架构中的 FIFO 队列在主内存中保留固定数量的 URL，并把大部分 URL 存储在磁盘上，以在商用硬件上支持高爬取速率。即使是最好的机器，考虑到互联网的规模，也需要磁盘支持。磁盘存储算法可能成为处理海量 URL 的瓶颈，因为对磁盘的读写非常频繁，正如 IRLBot 研究论文所指出的，该论文测试了每秒从被爬网页生成 184,000 个新 URL 的结果。

The current design and implementation of large-scale web crawlers such as Google and Bing are proprietary and are not available to the general public. We referenced several public research papers along with our own knowledge base to ensure that the web crawler system’s scalability could support today’s internet scale.
Google 和 Bing 等大规模网络爬虫的当前设计与实现是专有的，不对公众开放。我们参考了若干公开研究论文以及我们自己的知识库，以确保网络爬虫系统的扩缩能力能支持当今互联网的规模。

IRLBot suggests the disk repository with the update management (DRUM) algorithm as an algorithm for ensuring URL uniqueness. DRUM maintains k memory arrays, each of size M, and k disk buckets (Qi) and spreads key-value pairs between them based on the key. The data is moved to disk buckets as memory arrays get filled up. For pages with a lot of sub-URLs (in the millions), the politeness rate limiting can become a bottleneck. IRLBot solves this via the spam tracking and avoidance through reputation (STAR) algorithm. The reputation of a page is calculated based on in-degree links from other domain web pages. There is always a possibility that some web pages don’t show much relevance because they are new or have fewer in-degree links, but they should also be crawled to ensure that search engines can support any user queries. This is solved by the budget enforcement with anti-spam tactics (BEAST) algorithm. BEAST maintains an additional queue to all such URLs and keeps reevaluating their relevance to figure out when the URLs should be crawled by the web crawler system.

IRLBot 提出了 disk repository with update management（DRUM）算法作为确保 URL 唯一性的算法。DRUM 维护 k 个内存数组（每个大小为 M）和 k 个磁盘桶（Qi），并根据键在它们之间分布键值对。当内存数组填满时，数据被移到磁盘桶。对于有大量子 URL（数百万）的页面，礼貌限流可能成为瓶颈。IRLBot 通过 spam tracking and avoidance through reputation（STAR）算法解决这个问题。页面的声誉基于来自其他域名网页的入度链接计算。总有可能某些网页因为是新的或入度链接较少而不显示太多相关性，但它们也应被爬取，以确保搜索引擎能支持任何用户查询。这通过 budget enforcement with anti-spam tactics（BEAST）算法解决。BEAST 为所有这类 URL 维护一个额外队列，并不断重新评估它们的相关性，以弄清这些 URL 何时应由网络爬虫系统爬取。

Page 418

The web crawler system should also ensure that infinite-loop scenarios are avoided while crawling the web. It can happen that a URL is referenced at multiple places in a single web page (or on multiple web pages during a single crawl of the system) or that a URL contains a reference to itself.

网络爬虫系统还应确保在爬取 Web 时避免无限循环场景。可能发生一个 URL 在单个网页中被多处引用（或在系统单次爬取期间在多个网页上被引用），或一个 URL 包含对自身的引用。

URL uniqueness and duplicate detection

The system needs a mechanism for duplicate URL detection. This can be done by having a separate global database across the crawler machines that maintains the list of URLs visited in a single crawl. Since the query to determine whether the URL is a duplicate needs to be fast and doesn’t need to be persisted across the crawls, we can use Redis and store the URLs as keys. The Redis cluster can contain TTL policies associated with a URL (which vary from URL to URL) so that the URL is automatically removed from the cache.

系统需要一个重复 URL 检测机制。这可以通过在爬虫机器之间设一个独立的全局数据库来完成，该数据库维护单次爬取中已访问 URL 的列表。由于判断 URL 是否重复的查询需要快速、且不需要跨爬取持久化，我们可以使用 Redis 并把 URL 存为键。Redis 集群可以包含与 URL 关联的 TTL 策略（因 URL 而异），以便 URL 自动从缓存中移除。

Using Bloom filters is another technique for determining whether a URL was visited or not—the key consideration here is the probabilistic nature of Bloom filters. It is possible that the Bloom filter returns yes for an already-crawled URL, causing a recrawl of the URL.

使用 Bloom filter 是判断 URL 是否被访问过的另一种技术——这里关键考虑是 Bloom filter 的概率性质。Bloom filter 有可能对一个已爬过的 URL 返回 yes，导致该 URL 被重新爬取。

The crawler will also respect any exclusions on the web server configured in a robots.txt file. The robots.txt file determines whether a web page is allowed for crawling or whether any specific resource is not to be indexed by search engines. On top of exclusions by the web server, there are exclusions maintained by the web crawler to avoid visiting and indexing content from any blocked websites.

爬虫还会遵守 Web 服务器上在 robots.txt 文件中配置的任何排除规则。robots.txt 文件决定一个网页是否允许爬取，或某个特定资源是否不应被搜索引擎索引。除了 Web 服务器的排除之外，网络爬虫还维护自己的排除列表，以避免访问和索引任何被屏蔽网站的内容。

Let’s combine all the components we discussed to present a final picture of the web crawler system in Figure 15-5. There are a few additional items to consider for the system:

我们把讨论过的所有组件组合起来，在图 15-5 中呈现网络爬虫系统的最终图景。系统还有一些附加项要考虑：

  • The crawler is a multiregion deployment, and performance improves if the crawler crawls from the same location where a website is located. Some sites, such as government websites, are blocked from being accessed from other countries, so then it becomes necessary for the crawler to run in the same region where the site is located.
    爬虫是多区域部署，如果爬虫从网站所在的同一位置爬取，性能会提升。有些站点（例如政府网站）被阻止从其他国家访问，因此爬虫就有必要运行在该站点所在的同一区域。
  • The crawler mostly uses the HTTP/1.1 protocol version to retrieve web pages. It can use more recent HTTP versions, such as HTTP/2, depending on whether that’s supported by the website. The newer version saves computing resources for both the crawler and the website.
    爬虫主要使用 HTTP/1.1 协议版本检索网页。它可以使用更新的 HTTP 版本（例如 HTTP/2），取决于网站是否支持。更新的版本为爬虫和网站双方都节省计算资源。
  • The content on some websites can be so large that the web crawler always upper-caps on the bandwidth consumption. For example, it will only download 15 MB of content and skip the rest of it.
    某些网站上的内容可能非常大，以至于网络爬虫总是给带宽消耗设上限。例如，它只下载 15 MB 内容，跳过其余部分。
Page 419

The web crawler’s job finishes as soon as the web page is downloaded. The search engine system then takes this content as input and indexes it efficiently to serve user search queries. Let’s explore the architecture of the search engine system next.

网页一下载完，网络爬虫的工作就结束了。搜索引擎系统随后把这个内容作为输入，高效地索引它以服务用户搜索查询。下面我们探索搜索引擎系统的架构。

Designing the Search Engine

The search engine system takes a user query as input and provides relevant web pages in response to the query. The web pages are downloaded and stored to a repository (or some kind of database) by the web crawler system, which we discussed in the last section. The search engine should be able to figure out the best matching results for the user search query from this content repository. We’ll define a high-level architecture of the search engine system, as shown in Figure 15-6, and then explore each of the components.

搜索引擎系统以用户查询为输入，并提供相关网页作为查询响应。网页由网络爬虫系统下载并存储到一个仓库（或某种数据库），我们在上一节讨论过。搜索引擎应能从这个内容仓库中为用户搜索查询找出最佳匹配结果。我们将定义搜索引擎系统的高层架构，如图 15-6 所示，然后探索每个组件。

After the crawler downloads the web pages to the content store, the document parser and encoder is responsible for tasks like parsing the documents and removing unuseful data and then passing the data to the forward index. The forward index stores the data, and then it is passed to the inverted index for reverse mapping. For any user search query, the query is parsed to the search keywords. The content relevance system (such as PageRank) computes the most relevant results and returns them to the user.

爬虫把网页下载到内容存储后，文档解析器和编码器负责诸如解析文档、移除无用数据之类的任务，然后把数据传给前向索引。前向索引存储数据，然后它被传给倒排索引做反向映射。对于任何用户搜索查询，查询被解析为搜索关键词。内容相关性系统（例如 PageRank）计算最相关的结果并返回给用户。

You might wonder why we need a forward index in the architecture since the inverted index should be sufficient to serve user queries efficiently, and it’s a valid question. The creation of the forward index allows for storing the words as they are parsed from the web page, enabling the inverted index to be a completely independent process that can happen asynchronously. Several different open source solutions have been built to support the inverted-index data structure creation. Let’s discuss our options for the search engine system in the next section.

你可能会问：既然倒排索引应该足以高效服务用户查询，为什么架构中还需要前向索引？这是一个合理的问题。前向索引的创建允许按词从网页解析出来的原样存储它们，使倒排索引成为一个完全独立、可以异步发生的过程。已经有若干不同的开源方案被构建来支持倒排索引数据结构的创建。下一节我们讨论搜索引擎系统的选择。

Page 420

Indexing strategies

We’ll start the discussion by exploring the architecture of open source search solutions such as Elasticsearch and Amazon OpenSearch (which we discussed briefly in Chapter 10). Many organizations like Netflix use Elasticsearch to build inverted indexes and build search functionality on top of them. Elasticsearch is a nonrelational data store service that can be used to store JSON documents, and Elasticsearch constructs inverted indexes to support search queries on the stored data.

我们从探索 Elasticsearch 和 Amazon OpenSearch 等开源搜索方案的架构开始讨论（我们在第 10 章简要讨论过）。许多组织（如 Netflix）使用 Elasticsearch 构建倒排索引，并在其上构建搜索功能。Elasticsearch 是一个非关系型数据存储服务，可用于存储 JSON 文档，Elasticsearch 构建倒排索引以支持对所存储数据的搜索查询。

An index is quite similar to an Amazon RDS table. The indexes are further divided into subindexes called shards (the shards internally map to the Lucene index; Elasticsearch is built on top of Lucene). The documents are stored on the shards; a document is like a row in the RDS table. Each shard consists of multiple segments, which are kept in memory (and a transaction log on disk to overcome failures) and are synced to disk in fixed time intervals (referred to as refresh intervals). A segment is an immutable data structure and is available for search once it is saved to disk. If a use case requires data to be available for search as soon as it is written, the refresh interval can be configured to a lower value. The smaller segments are merged into a larger segment from time to time, improving the overall search performance (search needs to be performed on a smaller set of segments). We’ll discuss shard configurations more in Chapter 18.

index 与 Amazon RDS 表非常相似。index 进一步划分为称为 shard 的子索引（shard 内部映射到 Lucene index；Elasticsearch 构建在 Lucene 之上）。文档存储在 shard 上；一个文档就像 RDS 表中的一行。每个 shard 由多个 segment 组成，这些 segment 保留在内存中（并在磁盘上有一个事务日志以克服故障），并按固定时间间隔同步到磁盘（称为 refresh interval）。segment 是不可变数据结构，一旦保存到磁盘即可用于搜索。如果某个用例要求数据一写入就可搜索，可以把 refresh interval 配置为较低值。较小的 segment 不时合并成较大的 segment，从而提升整体搜索性能（只需在较小的 segment 集合上执行搜索）。我们将在第 18 章更多讨论 shard 配置。

To support high availability and read scale, the shards are replicated on multiple data nodes, as shown in Figure 15-7. The data is written to the primary shard on one of the data nodes and then replicated to replica shards asynchronously. The system tries to ensure that primary and replica shards are not colocated on the same data node (given that the Elasticsearch cluster has that number of nodes per the shards configuration).

为支持高可用和读扩缩，shard 被复制到多个数据节点上，如图 15-7 所示。数据被写到其中一个数据节点上的主 shard，然后异步复制到副本 shard。系统尽量确保主 shard 和副本 shard 不放在同一数据节点上（前提是 Elasticsearch 集群按 shard 配置有那么多节点）。

Page 421

Now take a look at data node 1 in Figure 15-7: it contains primary shard 1 and replicas for shards 2 and 3. The replicas are useful for scaling the read operations without affecting the write performance, but the key consideration here is that all three shards share the same CPU and RAM resources of the data node, where one shard is responsible for writes and the other two for reads. Elasticsearch uses disk to store the indexes and offers multiple caching techniques on top of that to make queries faster.

现在看图 15-7 中的数据节点 1：它包含主 shard 1，以及 shard 2 和 3 的副本。副本有助于在不影响写性能的情况下扩缩读操作，但这里关键考虑是三个 shard 共享数据节点相同的 CPU 和 RAM 资源，其中一个 shard 负责写，另外两个负责读。Elasticsearch 使用磁盘存储 index，并在其上提供多种缓存技术以使查询更快。

The reads can be scaled by adding more replicas, but what about the primary shard? If there are issues with a data node consisting of a primary shard, that can affect the indexing performance until the data node is recovered or replaced by some other node, becoming a bottleneck in the overall architecture. In Elasticsearch architecture, the search engine is responsible for indexing the data and uses the same index to support user search queries. This can potentially introduce a bottleneck of one operation affecting the performance of another, meaning reads and writes are happening on the index at the same time. There can be sudden traffic bursts in any one of them that impact the other—for example, a viral search keyword queried by a large number of users in the same timestamp. In Part II, we covered the architecture of multiple AWS services, and the key was decoupling compute and storage in services like Amazon Redshift, Amazon EMR, Amazon Aurora, and so on. Along similar lines, is it possible to architect the system in such a way that both write and read operations can scale independently and are completely decoupled?

读可以通过添加更多副本来扩缩，但主 shard 呢？如果一个包含主 shard 的数据节点出问题，那会影响索引性能，直到该数据节点被恢复或由其他节点替换，成为整体架构的瓶颈。在 Elasticsearch 架构中，搜索引擎负责索引数据，并使用同一个 index 支持用户搜索查询。这可能引入一个操作影响另一个操作性能的瓶颈，即读写同时发生在 index 上。其中任何一个都可能出现突发流量影响另一个——例如一个爆款搜索关键词在同一时间戳被大量用户查询。在第二部分中，我们覆盖了多个 AWS 服务的架构，关键是在 Amazon Redshift、Amazon EMR、Amazon Aurora 等服务中解耦计算和存储。沿着类似思路，是否有可能以一种方式架构系统，使读写操作都能独立扩缩并完全解耦？

To resolve this, we can leverage cloud object storage as intermediary storage where indexing engines can upload the data and search engines can download the data, as shown in Figure 15-8. Multipart upload and download ensure uploading of the large files in chunks to provide better reliability and ease in reuploading or redownloading

为解决这个问题，我们可以利用云对象存储作为中间存储，索引引擎可以上传数据、搜索引擎可以下载数据，如图 15-8 所示。分片上传和下载确保大文件以分块上传，从而在操作失败时提供更好的可靠性、并便于重新上传或重新下载

Page 422

a smaller chunk if the operation fails. Keep shard sizes relatively small (not too small, to only a few GBs), which helps improve indexing latency. This also makes scaling (adding or removing nodes) search and indexing clusters faster due to the reduction in data-rebalancing overhead.

较小的分块。保持 shard 大小相对较小（不要太小，只有几个 GB），这有助于改善索引延迟。这还由于数据再平衡开销的减少，使搜索和索引集群的扩缩（添加或移除节点）更快。

We’ll discuss optimal shard size for Elasticsearch clusters more in Chapter 18.
我们将在第 18 章更多讨论 Elasticsearch 集群的最佳 shard 大小。

The other benefits of cloud storage options like Amazon S3 are no management overhead of persistent backups and cross-AZ and -region replication. In short, we’re getting all the cloud storage availability benefits in the search engine system. It is always a point of discussion: deciding whether to use a cloud provider or to fully manage a custom solution on your own at such a huge scale. There is no foolproof answer, and we recommend reevaluating as your system requirements, cloud-pricing considerations, and need for control over the service evolve.

Amazon S3 等云存储选项的其他好处是：持久备份和跨 AZ、跨区域复制无需管理开销。简而言之，我们在搜索引擎系统中获得了所有云存储可用性好处。在如此巨大的规模下，是使用云提供商还是自己完全管理一个自定义方案，始终是一个讨论点。没有万无一失的答案，我们建议随着你的系统需求、云定价考虑和对服务控制的需求演进而重新评估。

We ensured that the indexing and search processes can scale independently. Now, to address the indexing-system bottleneck on write operations, the system can use the following mechanisms:

我们确保了索引和搜索过程可以独立扩缩。现在，为解决索引系统在写操作上的瓶颈，系统可以使用以下机制：

  • Write operations should be done in batch or bulk instead of single-write operations for each and every query. This will help reduce load on the system.
    写操作应批量或 bulk 进行，而不是对每个查询都做单次写操作。这有助于降低系统负载。
  • Instead of leader-follower (primary-secondary shard) architecture, the system can be designed to support leader-leader architecture where data is written to multiple primary shards at the same time, with a consensus and quorum algorithms in place. If there is a single leader, there is no requirement for consensus and quorum, so there are trade-offs in both approaches.
    系统可以设计为支持 leader-leader 架构，而不是 leader-follower（主-副 shard）架构，数据同时写到多个主 shard，并配有共识和法定人数算法。如果只有单个 leader，就不需要共识和法定人数，因此两种方法各有权衡。

We’re clear on the fact that we’re not using Elasticsearch or Amazon OpenSearch for building the search engine system and that we need a custom solution to build the

我们很清楚：构建搜索引擎系统时不使用 Elasticsearch 或 Amazon OpenSearch，我们需要一个自定义方案来构建

Page 423

inverted indexes. The custom solution can be built on top of Apache Lucene library or completely from scratch, depending on further analysis. An inverted index can be really huge given the amount of data, and the system will include a mechanism for dividing the data into multiple machines and clusters. A single huge index cluster is tough to manage compared to multiple small clusters (well, not too small) and can become a bottleneck in the architecture. How should an inverted index be divided into a set of machines? We can represent an inverted index as a mapping from a keyword to the list of doc IDs and the frequency of the word’s appearance in the document:

倒排索引。该自定义方案可以构建在 Apache Lucene 库之上，或完全从头开始，取决于进一步分析。鉴于数据量，倒排索引可能非常巨大，系统将包含一种把数据划分到多台机器和多个集群的机制。与多个小集群（嗯，不要太小）相比，单个巨大的 index 集群难以管理，并可能成为架构中的瓶颈。倒排索引应如何划分到一组机器上？我们可以把倒排索引表示为从关键词到 doc ID 列表以及该词在文档中出现频率的映射：

Term (key) - {docId, frequency} (value)
Hello - [{doc1, 5}, {doc2, 3}, {doc4, 1}]
World - [{doc1, 5}, {doc3, 4}]

There are two approaches to dividing the data here:

这里有两种划分数据的方法：

Document-based. All the terms from a document are stored on a single machine, offering the benefit of calculating page relevance easily (if all the words in a search query are present in a single document, the system can retrieve the result from a single machine only). To gather search results, the primary instance forwards the query to all the worker instances and then combines the results to respond to the user queries.

基于文档（Document-based）。一个文档中的所有 term 都存储在单台机器上，好处是容易计算页面相关性（如果一个搜索查询中的所有词都出现在单个文档中，系统只需从单台机器检索结果）。为收集搜索结果，主实例把查询转发给所有 worker 实例，然后合并结果以响应用户查询。

Term-based. To simply illustrate this, assume the system has extracted 100 terms out of the crawled web pages. These 100 terms are divided into a set of machines: 10 machines with 10 terms each. To respond to search queries, the primary instance can figure out which worker instances to go to; it doesn’t need all the workers as in the case of document-based partitioning. The downside of this approach is creating an intersection of search results because the terms corresponding to the same document can reside on different machines and require data transfer over the network.

基于 term（Term-based）。为简单说明，假设系统从被爬网页中提取了 100 个 term。这 100 个 term 被划分到一组机器上：10 台机器，每台 10 个 term。为响应搜索查询，主实例可以弄清该去哪些 worker 实例；不像基于文档分区那样需要所有 worker。这种方法的缺点是要创建搜索结果的交集，因为对应同一文档的 term 可能驻留在不同机器上，需要通过网络传输数据。

Based on these trade-offs, we’ll choose document-based partitioning to maintain the inverted indexes. Let’s discuss scaling of search nodes to facilitate the user read operations next.

基于这些权衡，我们选择基于文档分区来维护倒排索引。下面我们讨论搜索节点的扩缩以支持用户读操作。

Improving search performance

Latency is super critical; it is important that the user queries are answered in submilliseconds. The ideal suggestion is that the search nodes should keep all the data primarily in RAM, meaning all the inverted indexes are cached, but this comes with a cost. Disk is about a hundred times cheaper than RAM, and considering the scale requirements, the cost differentiation between disk and RAM can be huge.

延迟极其关键；用户查询必须在亚毫秒内得到回答。理想建议是搜索节点应主要把所有数据保留在 RAM 中，即所有倒排索引都被缓存，但这有成本。磁盘比 RAM 便宜约一百倍，考虑到规模需求，磁盘和 RAM 之间的成本差异可能巨大。

Page 424

In the case when all the data is kept in main memory, is there a requirement for persistent storage? For any node failures, the data can always be downloaded from cloud storage. It’s a tough call to make, and we recommend keeping the inverted indexes as backups in disk storage as well. Yes, they can always be downloaded from cloud storage, but that can take more time compared to local disk seeks.

在所有数据都保留在主内存的情况下，是否还需要持久存储？对于任何节点故障，数据总能从云存储下载。这是一个艰难的决定，我们建议把倒排索引也作为备份保留在磁盘存储中。是的，它们总能从云存储下载，但与本地磁盘寻址相比可能耗时更久。

There are pros and cons associated with any approach we take—whether indexes are completely in memory or disk. We can take a middle ground to keep the majority of indexes in memory (most frequently accessed) with disk as a persistence option. The indexing algorithm will ensure that the data is stored in a manner requiring minimum disk-seek operations (ideally, one). Compression of data then becomes important in case the maximum amount of data resides in the main memory.

无论索引完全在内存还是磁盘，我们采取的任何方法都有利弊。我们可以取中间立场：把大部分索引保留在内存中（最频繁访问的），磁盘作为持久化选项。索引算法将确保数据以需要最少磁盘寻址操作（理想情况下一次）的方式存储。如果最大量数据驻留在主内存中，数据压缩就变得重要。

Data compression

We discussed the storage space requirements for the web crawler based on a few assumptions in “System Requirements” on page 388. The general idea of compression is that the operations of compressing and then decompressing will add to the latency of both indexing and search. This is because the system is spending some time first compressing and then, at a later stage, decompressing the data to support user search queries. One thing we’re 100% sure of is that compression can save storage space.

我们在第 388 页“系统需求”中基于若干假设讨论了网络爬虫的存储空间需求。压缩的总体思路是：先压缩再解压的操作会增加索引和搜索两者的延迟。这是因为系统先花一些时间压缩数据，然后在稍后阶段解压数据以支持用户搜索查询。我们 100% 确定的一件事是：压缩可以节省存储空间。

Given that decompression can severely impact the search latency, we should think about latency a bit more. The search latency is critical in the system; indexing latency is also critical, but we can survive with a little lag because it is saving us the huge storage cost and we’re fine with an eventual consistent system. We’ll compare the considerations when the inverted index resides on disk versus when it resides completely in memory:

鉴于解压会严重影响搜索延迟，我们应再多想想延迟。搜索延迟在系统中是关键的；索引延迟也关键，但我们可以忍受一点滞后，因为它为我们节省了巨大的存储成本，而且我们对最终一致的系统也能接受。我们比较倒排索引驻留在磁盘与完全驻留在内存时的考虑：

Inverted index in memory. To process an inverted index list without compression requires two steps: moving data from memory to CPU cache and then processing it. With compression, an extra step of decompressing the data is added. The operation of moving data from memory to CPU cache becomes really fast with compressed data, and decompression takes relatively less time. So essentially, the search-query latency is improved with compression of the data.

内存中的倒排索引。处理未压缩的倒排索引列表需要两步：把数据从内存移到 CPU 缓存，然后处理它。使用压缩时，增加了一步解压数据。使用压缩数据时，把数据从内存移到 CPU 缓存的操作变得非常快，解压耗时相对更少。因此本质上，数据压缩改善了搜索查询延迟。

Inverted index on disk. This adds the step of moving the data from disk to main memory, but it performs well because we’re moving less data. This increases the search-query evaluation speed, giving us the benefit of low storage cost plus the improved performance with the compression in place in the system.

磁盘上的倒排索引。这增加了把数据从磁盘移到主内存的步骤，但它表现良好，因为我们移动的数据更少。这提高了搜索查询评估速度，既带来低存储成本的好处，又因系统中启用了压缩而提升性能。

Taking all of this into consideration, we can see that the search queries are quite faster in responding to user requests with compression in place.

综合考虑所有这些，我们可以看到：启用压缩后，搜索查询响应用户请求要快得多。

Page 425

Now think of a scenario when a particular search query becomes popular and the system receives a lot of requests with the same search query—this may become a bottleneck in the search system. To overcome this, the system ensures that autoscaling is in place to replicate the data on more nodes to serve queries. It also maintains a cache layer in the same region as users to serve the same search queries without even hitting the search system’s inverted indexes. This ensures that the search system is not affected and that user queries are served reliably and with much less latency. There is definitely an implementation in place to invalidate the regional cache from time to time and maintain the data freshness. As the search engine system creates inverted indexes, it assigns the score to each page to make sure relevant content is served to the users.

现在想一个场景：某个特定搜索查询走红，系统收到大量相同搜索查询的请求——这可能成为搜索系统的瓶颈。为克服这一点，系统确保有自动扩缩，把数据复制到更多节点上来服务查询。它还在与用户同一区域维护一个缓存层，甚至不用打搜索系统的倒排索引就能服务相同的搜索查询。这确保搜索系统不受影响，用户查询被可靠地、以低得多的延迟服务。当然也有实现来不时地使区域缓存失效并保持数据新鲜。当搜索引擎系统创建倒排索引时，它给每个页面打分，以确保向用户提供相关内容。

Relevance of search results

For any search query, there can be hundreds of search results, and the search engine system should ensure that the results are in a sorted format with high-scoring web pages on top. Here are few factors that contribute to deciding the content relevancy of a web page:

对于任何搜索查询，可能有数百个搜索结果，搜索引擎系统应确保结果是排序格式，高分网页在最前。下面是决定网页内容相关性的几个因素：

  • A web page is assigned a higher score if a lot of other web pages point to it. If some top domain adds the reference to the page as well, it becomes more relevant. For example, a research paper used as a reference on Stanford University’s site might hold more value than a research paper quoted on the sites of 10 lesser-known universities.
    如果很多其他网页指向一个网页，该网页会被打更高分。如果某个顶级域名也添加了对该页面的引用，它就更相关。例如，在斯坦福大学网站上被引用的研究论文，可能比在 10 所不太知名大学网站上被引用的研究论文更有价值。
  • The words in the web page title, the heading, a larger font, or any other special characteristics (e.g., embedded links, bold, italics, underlining, etc.) can be given more weight.
    网页标题、标题中、更大字号的词，或任何其他特殊特征（例如嵌入链接、粗体、斜体、下划线等）可以被赋予更大权重。
  • The location of the web page adds to a score in the sense that a web page could be very relevant in the US but not so relevant in India.
    网页的位置会加分，因为一个网页在美国可能非常相关，而在印度就没那么相关。
  • The search engine prioritizes positive content instead of negative content in top search results unless the search query explicitly evaluates to the negative content.
    搜索引擎在顶部搜索结果中优先正面内容而非负面内容，除非搜索查询明确指向负面内容。

Many more attributes can be used to determine a page rank, but we’ll close the search engine discussion here and move on to launching the system on the AWS cloud.

还有更多属性可用于决定 page rank，但我们在这里结束搜索引擎的讨论，转向在 AWS 云上上线系统。

Launching the System on AWS

As we did in Chapter 14, we’ll follow the policy of quickly setting up the application and choosing AWS services that require no or minimum expertise. Then, we’ll tackle issues as we understand more about how the overall system is functioning and the expectations of the users.

正如我们在第 14 章所做，我们将遵循快速搭建应用、选择无需或最少专业知识的 AWS 服务的策略。然后，随着我们更了解整体系统如何运作以及用户的期望，我们再处理问题。

Page 426

Day 0 Architecture

The Day 0 architecture is based on an AWS blog post about scaling up a serverless web crawler and search engine. The entire process of the web crawler system can be broken down into a series of steps, and it essentially keeps repeating these steps until the list of URLs is crawled. To break the workflow into steps, AWS Step Functions (discussed in Chapter 12) is a great choice of service on the AWS cloud. Figure 15-9 shows the state machine representing how the web crawler downloads web pages.

Day 0 架构基于一篇关于扩缩 serverless 网络爬虫和搜索引擎的 AWS 博客文章。网络爬虫系统的整个过程可以分解为一系列步骤，它本质上不断重复这些步骤，直到 URL 列表被爬完。要把工作流拆成步骤，AWS Step Functions（第 12 章讨论过）是 AWS 云上很好的服务选择。图 15-9 展示了表示网络爬虫如何下载网页的状态机。

All the states in the state machine can be executed as separate Lambda functions and use Step Functions map states for parallelization. There is also a requirement to store the URLs, which can be passed along between the states for evaluation, such as if the URL is already crawled or if there are more URLs to be crawled. Since the list of URLs is huge, it’s not possible to pass between the states using Step Functions alone—the system requires persistent storage. For database choices, the system doesn’t require any relations or strong consistency across the data, so a nonrelational service like Amazon DynamoDB or Amazon Keyspaces can be an ideal choice here. The system stores the available URLs and any related metadata and requires direct key operations on these URLs. We recommend using a database based on previous expertise here as neither of these two choices stands out clearly. For illustrative purposes, in this chapter we’ll use DynamoDB.

状态机中的所有状态都可以作为单独的 Lambda 函数执行，并使用 Step Functions map state 做并行化。还有一个存储 URL 的需求，这些 URL 可以在状态之间传递以做判断，例如 URL 是否已爬过，或是否还有更多 URL 要爬。由于 URL 列表巨大，仅用 Step Functions 无法在状态之间传递——系统需要持久存储。在数据库选择上，系统不需要数据之间的任何关系或强一致性，因此 Amazon DynamoDB 或 Amazon Keyspaces 这样的非关系型服务在这里是理想选择。系统存储可用 URL 和任何相关元数据，并需要对这些 URL 做直接键操作。我们建议基于既往经验选择数据库，因为这两个选择都没有明显胜出。出于说明目的，本章我们使用 DynamoDB。

The system essentially requires two tables. One is a building block of the URL frontier system to store URLs and is used across the crawls. Another is created at the start

系统本质上需要两张表。一张是 URL frontier 系统存储 URL 的构建块，跨多次爬取使用。另一张在状态机开始时创建、

Page 427

of the state machine and deleted at the termination of the state machine; this table stores the URLs crawled during the ongoing crawl to ensure that a single URL is not crawled multiple times.

在状态机终止时删除；这张表存储当前爬取期间已爬的 URL，以确保单个 URL 不会被多次爬取。

Once the web page is crawled by the crawler system, it needs a repository database to dump all the web page content. For such use cases, Amazon S3 is the preferred choice for storing the data, and it can be used in the second step of the architecture as a search engine to consume this data and index it. Building a custom search engine is a big task that requires an end-to-end thought process, but to deploy the system quickly, we can use Amazon Kendra, which we introduced very briefly in Chapter 13. Kendra is a fully managed service offering intelligent search capabilities. It is widely used as an enterprise search solution and is often targeted to build a custom search engine on top of internal documentation in multiple places, such as Slack, Google Drive, relational databases, Confluence docs, and so on. It offers connectors to connect with these different data sources and will automatically build a search solution on top of them. As the crawled web page data is stored to S3, the S3 connector can be used to configure S3 as a data source to Kendra. The entire architecture of the web crawler and search engine system after combining all these components is shown in Figure 15-10.

一旦网页被爬虫系统爬取，它就需要一个仓库数据库来倾倒所有网页内容。对于这类用例，Amazon S3 是存储数据的首选，它可以在架构的第二步作为搜索引擎消费这些数据并索引它。构建自定义搜索引擎是一项大任务，需要端到端的思考过程，但为快速部署系统，我们可以使用 Amazon Kendra，我们在第 13 章非常简要地介绍过它。Kendra 是一个提供智能搜索能力的全托管服务。它被广泛用作企业搜索方案，常被用于在多处内部文档（如 Slack、Google Drive、关系数据库、Confluence 文档等）之上构建自定义搜索引擎。它提供连接器来连接这些不同数据源，并自动在其上构建搜索方案。由于被爬网页数据存储到 S3，可以使用 S3 连接器把 S3 配置为 Kendra 的数据源。组合所有这些组件后，网络爬虫和搜索引擎系统的完整架构如图 15-10 所示。

Interestingly, Kendra also offers a web crawler as a connector, so we won’t even require the web crawler part of the architecture. All we need to do is provide the seed URLs, and Kendra can crawl the websites and index them to support the search on top of that. Let’s now look at any limitations the system can face as it scales to serve more and more traffic.

有趣的是，Kendra 还提供一个网络爬虫作为连接器，因此我们甚至不需要架构中的网络爬虫部分。我们所要做的就是提供 seed URL，Kendra 就能爬取这些网站并索引它们，以在其上支持搜索。下面我们看看系统在扩缩到服务越来越多流量时可能面临的任何局限。

Page 428

Scaling to Millions and Beyond

If you ignore infrastructure cost on the AWS cloud for a while, can you think of any limitations in the architecture explained in the previous section? Ideally, the architecture uses AWS serverless components, so the components should automatically scale up and down according to the nature of the traffic without any user interference. Possible limitations include:

如果你暂时忽略 AWS 云上的基础设施成本，你能想出上一节所解释架构中的任何局限吗？理想情况下，架构使用 AWS serverless 组件，因此组件应根据流量性质自动上下扩缩，无需任何用户干预。可能的局限包括：

  • AWS Step Functions can face higher latency and quota limitations. This was addressed by suggesting multiple Step Functions and usage of map states.
    AWS Step Functions 可能面临更高延迟和配额限制。这通过建议使用多个 Step Functions 和使用 map state 来解决。
  • AWS Lambda as a compute option scales automatically per the provided memory configurations. The cold start is not much of an issue because the system can survive a little lag, but we can still leverage a few of the options, such as provisioned capacity, to speed up the process of downloading web pages a little.
    AWS Lambda 作为计算选项按所提供的内存配置自动扩缩。冷启动不是大问题，因为系统可以忍受一点滞后，但我们仍可以利用一些选项（例如预置容量）来稍微加快下载网页的过程。
  • Amazon DynamoDB is a fully managed service that scales indefinitely to support the storage requirements. One point of consideration here is the hard limit for RCU and WCU consumption on a single partition: it should exceed the limit of 1,000 WCUs and 3,000 RCUs or else the requests are throttled. The DynamoDB table is created with the partition key as a URL. Considering that one RCU is consumed for one request, the system can breach this limit if the following situation occurs: a URL is referenced in a lot of web pages, and the web crawler is working concurrently on more than 3,000 URLs. The positive side of this could be that even if the requests are throttled, we can assume the URL is already present in the DynamoDB table and safely skip it (the request was throttled because the partition is present in the DynamoDB). The problem that can surface is retrieval of additional attributes associated with a URL.
    Amazon DynamoDB 是全托管服务，可无限扩缩以支持存储需求。这里一点要考虑的是单个分区上 RCU 和 WCU 消耗的硬限制：它不应超过 1,000 WCU 和 3,000 RCU 的限制，否则请求会被限流。DynamoDB 表以 URL 为分区键创建。考虑到一个请求消耗一个 RCU，如果发生以下情况，系统可能突破这个限制：一个 URL 被很多网页引用，而网络爬虫并发处理超过 3,000 个 URL。积极的一面是：即使请求被限流，我们也可以假设该 URL 已在 DynamoDB 表中并安全跳过它（请求被限流是因为该分区已存在于 DynamoDB 中）。可能浮现的问题是检索与 URL 关联的附加属性。
  • We can consider latency as one parameter on URL retrieval from DynamoDB since there is no caching introduced in the system. Further, the system doesn’t store robots cache and DNS cache, which adds to the overall latency of calls to web servers.
    由于系统中没有引入缓存，我们可以把延迟作为从 DynamoDB 检索 URL 的一个参数。此外，系统不存储 robots 缓存和 DNS 缓存，这增加了调用 Web 服务器的整体延迟。
  • The web page content is stored in S3, which offers unlimited storage and automatically replicates the data for high availability, so there’s no bottleneck there.
    网页内容存储在 S3，它提供无限存储并自动复制数据以高可用，因此那里没有瓶颈。
  • Amazon Kendra is a fully managed service, so we don’t control how data is stored or what capacity is offered to the customers. The service offers fixed capacity for storage and queries to the customers, and it can be further incremented with the help of AWS support. This control is often preferred at the customer’s end if the system needs to support a huge scale because that makes it easy to custom-build the software according to need.
    Amazon Kendra 是全托管服务，因此我们不控制数据如何存储或向客户提供什么容量。该服务向客户提供固定的存储和查询容量，可以在 AWS support 的帮助下进一步增加。如果系统需要支持巨大规模，客户端通常更偏好这种控制权，因为它使得按需定制软件变得容易。

If your system is operating at Google’s scale, or even one-tenth of this scale, it makes sense to manage the implementation on your own instead of relying on managed

如果你的系统在 Google 的规模上运行，甚至只是这个规模的十分之一，那么自己管理实现而不是依赖托管

Page 429

services like Kendra. This saves cost along with offering fine-tuned control over low-level configurations of the system.

服务（如 Kendra）是合理的。这既节省成本，又提供对系统底层配置的精细控制。

We’re not discouraging you from using AWS managed services—they are great and save a lot of time when building software without requiring any operational burden and expertise on your end. Evaluate your system architecture from time to time and deciding what works best for you.
我们不是在劝阻你使用 AWS 托管服务——它们很棒，在构建软件时能节省大量时间，且不需要你方承担任何运维负担和专业知识。不时评估你的系统架构，决定什么最适合你。

In Day 0 architecture, we used Kendra to help with the search engine functionalities. Now, let’s figure out which microservices can replace Kendra (referencing the functionality from Figure 15-10) and build the architecture from the ground up:

在 Day 0 架构中，我们使用 Kendra 来辅助搜索引擎功能。现在，我们弄清哪些微服务可以替换 Kendra（参考图 15-10 中的功能），并从零构建架构：

Text-preprocessing service. This service takes care of text filtering and removes unwanted stop words, and it then creates a forward index with a relevant set of words. This is not a straightforward implementation of direct removal of words and can include multiple options to consider. For example, you can perform a Google search on entire sentences by entering them in double quotes (and to support these search queries, the system needs to index the entire sentence).

文本预处理服务（Text-preprocessing service）。这个服务负责文本过滤，移除不需要的停用词，然后用一组相关词创建前向索引。这不是直接删词的简单实现，可能包含多个要考虑的选项。例如，你可以用双引号输入整个句子在 Google 上搜索（为支持这些搜索查询，系统需要索引整个句子）。

Inverted index creation service. This service is responsible for taking input as a forward index and creating an inverted index for the content. The inverted indexes are uploaded to S3 and downloaded by the inverted index reader service.

倒排索引创建服务（Inverted index creation service）。这个服务以前向索引作为输入，为内容创建倒排索引。倒排索引被上传到 S3，并由倒排索引读取服务下载。

Inverted index reader service. This service downloads the inverted indexes and handles the read queries from the search keyword parser service.

倒排索引读取服务（Inverted index reader service）。这个服务下载倒排索引，并处理来自搜索关键词解析服务的读查询。

Content relevance service. This service is responsible for hosting algorithms to get the most relevant content for given search keywords. There can be multiple services for content relevance, and each can work on different sets of criteria, such as geographical proximity or personal user interests.

内容相关性服务（Content relevance service）。这个服务负责托管算法，以针对给定搜索关键词获得最相关内容。内容相关性可以有多个服务，每个都可在不同标准集上工作，例如地理邻近性或个人用户兴趣。

Search keyword parser service. This service parses the user input into a set of keywords for further use by the content relevance service and inverted index reader service. The results are combined and returned to the frontend service.

搜索关键词解析服务（Search keyword parser service）。这个服务把用户输入解析为一组关键词，供内容相关性服务和倒排索引读取服务进一步使用。结果被合并并返回给前端服务。

Frontend service. This service takes actions on user requests, such as applying rate limiting and discarding unwanted traffic. It is essentially a gatekeeper service that forwards only actual traffic to backend services.

前端服务（Frontend service）。这个服务对用户请求采取动作，例如应用限流和丢弃不需要的流量。它本质上是一个守门人服务，只把真实流量转发给后端服务。

Page 430

A lot of things can happen in the system, and the system should be resilient to handle the fault scenarios gracefully. You can build confidence by intentionally breaking the production environment on known parameters and seeing if the system can handle the faults. This practice is called chaos engineering: the discipline of experimenting on a system to build confidence in the system’s capability to withstand turbulent conditions in production. The experiment can be as simple as an EC2 instance being down; is it replaced by another one? In the AWS cloud environment, you could use AWS Fault Injection Service (FIS). A lot of open source alternatives are also available for running these experiments.

系统中可能发生很多事情，系统应有弹性优雅地处理故障场景。你可以通过在已知参数上有意破坏生产环境、观察系统能否处理故障来建立信心。这种实践称为混沌工程：对系统做实验以建立对系统在生产中承受动荡条件能力的信心的学科。实验可以简单到就是一个 EC2 实例宕机；它是否被另一个替换？在 AWS 云环境中，你可以使用 AWS Fault Injection Service（FIS）。也有很多开源替代方案可用于运行这些实验。

Now, let’s incorporate all the components and complete the final architecture on AWS.

现在我们把所有组件整合起来，完成 AWS 上的最终架构。

Day N Architecture

You can definitely start with a single AWS account, but for Day N architecture, we recommend breaking the architecture into subcomponents with proper resource isolation—as we already did in the previous sections. To start, let’s assume there are two teams in the organization that independently own the web crawler and search engine systems (there can be more, such as teams that own ML initiatives, infrastructure management teams, or subteams for the web crawler and search engine systems). Both teams deploy their architectures into separate AWS accounts managed under the parent AWS account.

你当然可以从单个 AWS 账户开始，但对于 Day N 架构，我们建议把架构拆成带恰当资源隔离的子组件——正如我们在前面各节所做。首先，假设组织中有两个团队各自独立拥有网络爬虫和搜索引擎系统（可以更多，例如拥有 ML 项目的团队、基础设施管理团队，或网络爬虫和搜索引擎系统的子团队）。两个团队都把各自架构部署到由父 AWS 账户管理的独立 AWS 账户中。

There are no strict guidelines for how many AWS accounts you should have. Different organizations take different approaches based on their requirements. For example, it is very common for organizations to have separate accounts for each microservice (and even different AWS accounts at the regional level for multiregion deployment of critical services), while some organizations keep a single AWS account to manage all the resources across the microservices. In Chapter 14, we mentioned that having multiple AWS accounts can increase data-flow costs, but it simplifies certain other things, such as billing, complete resource isolation, and development flexibility for teams.

关于应有多少个 AWS 账户，没有严格准则。不同组织根据其需求采取不同方法。例如，组织为每个微服务设独立账户非常普遍（关键服务多区域部署时甚至在区域级别设不同 AWS 账户），而有些组织用单个 AWS 账户管理跨微服务的所有资源。在第 14 章我们提到，多个 AWS 账户会增加数据流成本，但它简化了其他一些事情，例如计费、完全资源隔离和团队开发灵活性。

As in previous sections, we’ll now present the final architecture broken down into two subsystems, starting with the web crawler.

正如前面各节，我们现在呈现拆成两个子系统的最终架构，从网络爬虫开始。

Web crawler

Let’s revisit Figure 15-5 and figure out the AWS services and resources that can be used to deploy the suggested architecture on the AWS cloud, starting with the multiple databases used. The web crawler research papers suggest different data structure implementations to store and reference the data, though we’ll evaluate if existing storage options on AWS can suffice for the use case in Table 15-1.

我们回顾图 15-5，弄清可以用哪些 AWS 服务和资源在 AWS 云上部署所建议的架构，从所使用的多个数据库开始。网络爬虫研究论文建议了不同的数据结构实现来存储和引用数据，但我们将评估 AWS 上现有的存储选项是否足以满足表 15-1 中的用例。

Page 431
Use caseAWS serviceComments
Seed URLDynamoDBThe URL frontier system takes the URLs from this system to begin the crawling process. DynamoDB is a preferred choice because it maintains a direct mapping (key-value pair from the URL to additional metadata) with no requirements for data relationships and strong consistency over the database indexes.
URL storage and URL uniquenessDynamoDBThis stores all the lists of the URLs that the system finds during the crawling of web pages. The URLs are added to this database after checking if they are not already present.
URL filterDynamoDBThis database maintains the blocked URLs that the crawler system doesn’t want to crawl.
Robots cacheDynamoDB and/or ElastiCacheBoth of these caching solutions help save time during the crawls. ElastiCache can be used alone as well as to improve the latency with disk persistence (to recover data in case of node failures). The robots cache helps the system figure out any exclusions on subsequent crawls even before crawling.
DNS cacheDynamoDB and/or ElastiCacheThe DNS cache maintains the IP address of the web server without making the round trip to the internet.
Webpage contentS3 and DynamoDBS3 is an object storage solution that is a preferred choice for storing content like text files, images, videos, and the like, so we can use it to store the web pages. DynamoDB can store any metadata, such as URL-to-S3 file paths for web page content (which is helpful across the web page crawls).
表 15-1：网络爬虫数据存储。① Seed URL 用 DynamoDB：URL frontier 系统从这个系统取 URL 开始爬取。DynamoDB 是首选，因为它维护直接映射（URL 到附加元数据的键值对），不需要数据关系，也不对数据库索引做强一致性。② URL 存储与 URL 唯一性用 DynamoDB：存储系统在爬网页过程中发现的所有 URL 列表。URL 经检查不存在后才加入此数据库。③ URL 过滤器用 DynamoDB：维护爬虫系统不想爬的被屏蔽 URL。④ robots 缓存用 DynamoDB 和/或 ElastiCache：两种缓存方案都有助于在爬取中节省时间。ElastiCache 可单独使用，也可配合磁盘持久化改善延迟（节点故障时恢复数据）。robots 缓存帮助系统在后续爬取中甚至在爬之前就弄清任何排除规则。⑤ DNS 缓存用 DynamoDB 和/或 ElastiCache：DNS 缓存维护 Web 服务器的 IP 地址，无需往返互联网。⑥ 网页内容用 S3 和 DynamoDB：S3 是对象存储方案，是存储文本文件、图片、视频等内容的首选，因此可用它存网页。DynamoDB 可存储任何元数据，例如网页内容的 URL 到 S3 文件路径的映射（这在跨网页爬取中很有用）。

Implementing the URL frontier system requires queues for URL processing so that it can push URLs to the queues and they can be consumed by the web crawler system for further processing. We’ll leverage a combination of Amazon SQS and Amazon SNS for this purpose; Amazon MSK can be used for the same purpose as well. The URL frontier publishes URLs to a single SNS topic, and it can route subscribed SQS FIFO queues based on priority attributes in the message. The URL fetcher system requires an additional NAT gateway and internet gateway to communicate with the internet to retrieve the web pages.

实现 URL frontier 系统需要用于 URL 处理的队列，以便它能把 URL 推到队列，并由网络爬虫系统消费做进一步处理。我们将利用 Amazon SQS 和 Amazon SNS 的组合来实现；Amazon MSK 也可用于同一目的。URL frontier 把 URL 发布到单个 SNS topic，并能根据消息中的优先级属性路由已订阅的 SQS FIFO 队列。URL 抓取系统需要额外的 NAT 网关和互联网网关，以与互联网通信来检索网页。

The entire crawler processing is essentially a sequence of steps, and it makes sense to use a state machine such as AWS Step Functions or Amazon MWAA (discussed in Chapter 12) at a large scale as well. We can definitely build our own state machines, but using these AWS services helps us leverage the built-in debugging features along with the error-handling mechanisms. The web crawler system architecture fits an event-driven system well: a system completes its processing and announces the completion status; the other system takes this output as input and begins its processing and so on. We can also achieve this via an SNS-SQS architecture instead of Step Functions. We compared choreography and orchestration design patterns in Chapter 8, and the same is applicable here: orchestration (AWS Step Functions) can be preferable to choreography (SQS-SNS) because of additional built-in features of AWS Step Functions, such as error handling and ease of debugging.

整个爬虫处理本质上是一系列步骤，在大规模下使用 AWS Step Functions 或 Amazon MWAA（第 12 章讨论过）这样的状态机也是合理的。我们当然可以构建自己的状态机，但使用这些 AWS 服务帮助我们利用内置调试特性以及错误处理机制。网络爬虫系统架构很适合事件驱动系统：一个系统完成处理并宣布完成状态；另一个系统把这个输出作为输入开始自己的处理，依此类推。我们也可以通过 SNS-SQS 架构而非 Step Functions 来实现。我们在第 8 章比较了 choreography 和 orchestration 设计模式，这里同样适用：orchestration（AWS Step Functions）可能优于 choreography（SQS-SNS），因为 AWS Step Functions 有额外的内置特性，例如错误处理和易于调试。

Page 432

Selecting compute options is another important factor for application deployment, and we recommend taking the learnings from Chapter 11 for different types of compute. In short, there is no perfect answer, and we try to take a middle ground by choosing the Amazon EKS EC2 deployment option. We consider this a middle ground based on our previous experience with the technologies and traffic analysis or quota limits enforced by AWS. As in Chapter 14, for better resource isolation we’ll deploy the microservices in different VPCs and use a separate Amazon EKS cluster for each of the microservices, as shown in Figure 15-11.

选择计算选项是应用部署的另一个重要因素，我们建议借鉴第 11 章对不同计算类型的学习。简而言之，没有完美答案，我们尝试通过选择 Amazon EKS EC2 部署选项取中间立场。基于我们既往对这些技术的经验、流量分析或 AWS 强制的配额限制，我们认为这是中间立场。正如第 14 章，为更好的资源隔离，我们将把微服务部署在不同 VPC 中，并为每个微服务使用单独的 Amazon EKS 集群，如图 15-11 所示。

AWS services for monitoring, managing access, and logging are not included in the architecture to keep the diagram less cluttered. Assume them as part of any architecture for overall observability.
用于监控、访问管理和日志的 AWS 服务未包含在架构中，以保持图面整洁。请把它们视为任何架构的一部分，以实现整体可观测性。

As the web pages are ingested into the content storage system, the web crawler system notifies the search engine system about the new content. Upon receiving this notification, the search engine system begins its processing of the creation of indexes. We’ll discuss the AWS architecture of the search engine system next.

当网页被摄入内容存储系统时，网络爬虫系统通知搜索引擎系统有新内容。收到此通知后，搜索引擎系统开始其创建索引的处理。下面我们讨论搜索引擎系统的 AWS 架构。

Search engine

We described the high-level architecture of the search engine system in Figure 15-6 and microservices in “Scaling to Millions and Beyond” on page 407. We’ll go with a framework similar to the web crawler system for application deployment. For creating forward and inverted indexes, we won’t be relying on any of the AWS services, such as Amazon OpenSearch for search functionality; instead, we’ll create custom solutions following the guidelines laid out in “Designing the Search Engine” on page 398. Figures 15-12 and 15-13 illustrate the search engine system’s architecture on the AWS cloud.

我们在图 15-6 中描述了搜索引擎系统的高层架构，在第 407 页“扩缩到数百万及以上”中描述了微服务。我们将采用与网络爬虫系统类似的框架做应用部署。创建前向和倒排索引时，我们不依赖任何 AWS 服务（例如用于搜索功能的 Amazon OpenSearch）；相反，我们将遵循第 398 页“设计搜索引擎”中列出的指南创建自定义方案。图 15-12 和图 15-13 展示了搜索引擎系统在 AWS 云上的架构。

Page 434

The content reader application reads the content from a repository stored by the web crawler system, performs preprocessing actions, and makes the content ready for forward index creation. We’ll use S3 to store large files like web pages and forward and inverted indexes and use them across the system. Amazon DynamoDB is used for any metadata storage requirements in the architecture. The forward index creator system constructs forward indexes using the output from the previous step, which is used as input to the inverted index creator system to construct inverted indexes. The inverted index reader application downloads the inverted indexes created by the inverted index creator system and allows reads on top of them. The content relevance system consists of multiple applications to figure out the relevance of search results and can use services such as Amazon SageMaker for running any ML algorithms. The frontend system takes in user queries, preprocesses them with the help of the query parser system, and then returns results with the help of the relevance and reader systems.

内容读取应用从网络爬虫系统存储的仓库中读取内容，执行预处理动作，使内容准备好用于创建前向索引。我们将使用 S3 存储网页以及前向和倒排索引等大文件，并在整个系统中使用它们。Amazon DynamoDB 用于架构中任何元数据存储需求。前向索引创建系统使用上一步的输出构建前向索引，该输出作为倒排索引创建系统的输入来构建倒排索引。倒排索引读取应用下载由倒排索引创建系统创建的倒排索引，并在其上允许读取。内容相关性系统由多个应用组成，用于弄清搜索结果的相关性，并可使用 Amazon SageMaker 等服务运行任何 ML 算法。前端系统接收用户查询，在查询解析系统的帮助下预处理它们，然后在相关性和读取系统的帮助下返回结果。

Page 435

Conclusion

Web crawler and search engine systems are complex architectures and require a lot of iteration to crawl the web efficiently and present the most relevant search results to the users. Content relevance algorithms hold a very important place in search engines because users care about good search results only and nothing else. This is true for any system design—as long as we’re able to serve users in the best way possible, nothing else matters. Design decisions should include user inputs as concrete functional requirements.

网络爬虫和搜索引擎系统是复杂的架构，需要大量迭代才能高效爬取 Web 并向用户呈现最相关的搜索结果。内容相关性算法在搜索引擎中占有非常重要的地位，因为用户只关心好的搜索结果，别的都不在乎。这对任何系统设计都成立——只要我们能以最好的方式服务用户，其他都不重要。设计决策应把用户输入作为具体功能需求包含进来。

Over the years, multiple papers have been published on distributed web crawlers and search engines, and we recommend reading them before implementing one of your own. This will help you avoid reinventing the wheel, and you can take inspiration from work that has already been done. We made some critical comparisons while choosing a technology for the system architecture, such as in-memory inverted indexes versus on-disk inverted indexes and using Amazon OpenSearch versus building custom solutions. Create a list of pros and cons mapping to your system requirements to finalize on a solution from all the available choices.

多年来，关于分布式网络爬虫和搜索引擎已发表多篇论文，我们建议在自己实现一个之前阅读它们。这将帮助你避免重造轮子，你可以从已完成的工作中汲取灵感。在为系统架构选择技术时，我们做了一些关键比较，例如内存倒排索引 vs 磁盘倒排索引，以及使用 Amazon OpenSearch vs 构建自定义方案。创建一个对应你系统需求的优缺点清单，从所有可用选择中最终确定一个方案。
